generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The bidder shall have proven experience in the field of similar nature of electrical works involving Erection/repair/rewinding and testing of 1450 KW, 3.3KV and above rating of HT Motor BHEL make in any thermal power plant of 210MW & above/ or in any reputed PSUs during any one year in preceding five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-2025 & 2025-26. As a proof, the bidder shall submit documentary evidence in the form of copy of Purchase/work orders as single work order amounting to Rs.19.65 Lakhs, along with performance certificate/work completion certificate in respect of the PQR along with the bid in part-I cover. The certificates shall be issued by General Manager/ Chief Engineer/ Head of the Company or Electricity Board/ Industrial Units or by competent authority.

The Bidder shall be a Manufacturer or Authorized Dealer or service provider of HT Motors. As a proof of which the bidder shall furnish Company Registration Certificate/dealership /authorization certificate along with credentials

The intending bidder should have achieved in any two financial years during last five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-2025 & 2025-26) an average annual financial turnover shall not be less than Rs.39.30 lakhs. The bidder shall submit certified copy of Annual Turnover of corresponding two years certified by the Chartered Accountant and same shall be uploaded along with the Technical bid.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair/Rectification of 3.3KV, 1450KW, CEP-2B motor at YTPS

itemList.description: Supplying and installation/replacing of new DE side bearing housing of 3.3KV 1450KW CEP-2B motor.
Supplying and installation of new DE side bearing no: 6234 M/C3 (SKF Make) for 3.3KV 1450KW CEP-2B motor.
Supplying and installation of new NDE side bearing no: 7332 BCBM (SKF Make) for 3.3KV 1450KW CEP-2B motor.
Replacement of existing 75 sqmm terminal leads to 120 Sqmm for all terminal leads including netrual side.
Supply and installation of new PSTB terminal box inplace of existing terminal box as per the drawing enclosed and as directed by site engineer.
Transportation charges of 3.3KV 1450KW CEP-2B motor from YTPS to and fro including all leads and loading and Transit Insurance and taxes etc.,.
Repair/rectification of stator winding, Complete Overhauling and Servicing of motor and rotor, painting, testing at work shop and at YTPS site and commissioning at site as directed by site engineer.
Complete Rotor Dynamic balancing of rotor @low speed for 2.5G of 3.3KV 1450KW CEP-2B motor.

11 kV, 3 Core, XPLE HTUG Cable with pressure extruded inner sheeth, ROUND WIRE ARMOURED as per IS-7098 (Part-2) Armouring wires dia and Resistivity as per IS-3975. 240 Sqmm, (55 GI Wires - 3.15 mm Dia).

Laying of cable in Existing Trench/GI pipe/Stone Ware/Cable Tray/RCC Hume pipe using Wooden/Aluminum Rollers as directed by the departmental staff and cable tray erection as and where required as directed by site engineer. HT Cables of sizes  3Cx 240 sqmm
11 kV, Jointing & Cable Termination Kit as per IS-13573.Heat Shrinkable Outdoor Type Cable Termination Kit for XLPE Cable. 3x240 Sqmm
Erection of coupling and alignment with existing pump shaft of  3.3KV 1450KW CEP-2B HT motor as per the site requirement and as directed by site engineers.
